description: Everyone is welcome. Join this team because you can.
summary: One of the main things that keeps people from astronomy is how complex it is. It can seem intimidating, as there are a lot of things that go into space missions, but it doesn't have to be. My game aims to educate people about two of the most influential spacecraft ever flow, Saturn V and the NASA Space Shuttle. After you've taken a look at them, you can take a quiz to test you knowledge! Have fun! Hover over parts of the spacecraft to learn more about them. Press the arrow keys to move left and right.
details: This project aims to let people learn more about how different NASA spacecraft work, especially the NASA Space Shuttle and Saturn V. It's a fun interactive game made to increase your understanding of space missions in a simple, fun way. All of the art for this game was made by hand, not with AI!
